title: Gallery label workbench
brief:
Complete the following real project in the current, initially empty directory. Choose the deliverables, media, tools, structure and implementation that serve the intended user. Build usable artifacts and check your work. Deliver the project itself. Omit personally identifying credits, author signatures and model or toolchain identity labels. No network access or credentials are provided.

Build an offline label workbench for a volunteer preparing a gallery show. Each artwork has a title, fictional artist display name, year, medium, dimensions, and optional credit line. Include three sample works: Tide Marks, graphite on paper, 2024, 21 × 30 cm; Window Light After Rain, oil on panel, 2025, 40 × 50 cm; and Fold Study IV, folded linen, 2023, 18 × 18 × 6 cm. Let the volunteer edit and reorder works, preview their labels, and print a checklist in matching order. Labels should fit a 90 × 55 mm trim size on A4 paper. Warn about text overflow while preserving the entered text.
